title: RES↔PO-001: Research Roadmap + Product-Driven Research Questions
description: Researcher provides a research roadmap aligned to product vision (active directions, expected Technology Transfer readiness dates with confidence, resource needs), research-horizon briefings, feasibility input on research-intensive features, and research-direction change notifications; Product Owner/TPM provides product vision/strategic direction, market-driven problem statements/research questions, and technology-transfer prioritization guidance. Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.2 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.14.

expected_trl.description: Technology Readiness Level (1–9); TRL ≥ 5 required for transfer.

transfer_prioritization_guidance.description: Guidance when engineering bandwidth is limited.

research_direction_change.description: Researcher notifies within 5 business days; PO impact assessment within 10.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Roadmap alignment and research-question intake are agent-autonomous. A technology transfer itself runs through the Tier-2 RES↔ARCH-TTP-001 gate (TRL ≥ 5).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (Quarterly Research-Product Alignment Review — 2nd Tuesday Feb/May/Aug/Nov; research-direction change notified ≤5 business days, PO impact assessment ≤10 business days; Annual Innovation Portfolio Review)
confirm_conditions: each active_direction carries a TRL and a transfer_confidence level
expected_transfer_date present for directions approaching readiness
research_questions carry a market-driven problem statement
a research_direction_change carries notified_date and product_impact_due_date
reject_conditions: a transfer asserted ready at TRL < 5 (transfer gate requires TRL ≥ 5; see RES↔ARCH-TTP-001)
transfer-readiness date stated without a confidence level (over-commitment)
counter_conditions: product-driven research question requires fundamental research with low success probability — request expectation-setting on duration/risk
roadmap direction lacks commercial relevance signal — request product-vision linkage before portfolio commit
